title: How'd We Get Pickled
style: 1920s australian vaudeville banjo, 144 BPM, plucked banjo lead, kazoo, washboard percussion, ukulele strum, jaunty upright bass, comedic male vocal with broad aussie accent, sing-along chorus, music hall energy, cheeky and self-deprecating, happy bouncing tempo
lyrics:
[Intro — banjo roll, kazoo trill]
Oi oi oi! How'd we get pickled?
Eight to nothin' and we should've been ticklin'!

[Verse 1]
We were up nine to two, mate, the whole thing in the bag
Then me brain fell out, and me feet kept on the drag
I was waltzin' to the kitchen like a goose in a frock
While me partner watched me serve into the lamp post and the rock

[Pre-Chorus]
Feet were movin', brain was sleepin'
Eyes on the seagull, ball was creepin'
Drove a winner — straight into the fence
Lost me marbles, lost me sense

[Chorus]
We got pickled! Pickled in the pickleball!
Eleven to nothin' and we shouldn't've lost at all!
Pickled, pickled, how'd we get pickled?
Brain on holiday and the scoreline tickled!
Crikey, we got pickled!

[Verse 2]
She had a paddle made of plywood, she was eighty-three
Hummin' Waltzing Matilda while she pickled you and me
I tried to drive a forehand, hit me partner in the shin
Said sorry to the umpire — there was no umpire in!

[Pre-Chorus]
Feet were movin', brain was vacant
Mind in Brisbane, body in adjacent
Soft hands? Mate, I had soft EVERYTHING
Even me serve apologised on the swing

[Chorus]
We got pickled! Pickled in the pickleball!
Eleven to nothin' and we shouldn't've lost at all!
Pickled, pickled, how'd we get pickled?
Brain on holiday and the scoreline tickled!
Crikey, we got pickled!

[Bridge — banjo solo, then spoken]
[spoken, cheeky] How'd we get pickled, mate?
Well, I was thinkin' about a meat pie at point seven
By point nine I was orderin' the pie in me head
By point eleven the pie was gone and so were we!

[Verse 3]
The grannies shook our hands like they pitied us a touch
Said "good game young fellas" — they didn't mean it much
Walked off the court with a sunburn and a sigh
Pickled by a lady with a knee brace and a cry of —

[Final Chorus — bigger, banjo cranked]
WE GOT PICKLED! Pickled in the pickleball!
Eleven to nothin' and we shouldn't've lost at all!
Pickled, pickled, how'd we get pickled?
Brain on holiday and the scoreline tickled!
CRIKEY, we got PICKLED!

[Outro — banjo ritard, kazoo whoop]
How'd we get pickled?
Beats me, mate.
Same time next Tuesday?
Too right.
